title: Function Health Lab Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=function:lab
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by marker_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Function Health lab data has stopped arriving for a given marker.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per marker and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It scores when one part of your Function Health lab feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
